author: kateis8
title: SO FUN & ADDICTING but a few small gripes
content: I’m obsessed with this app and play it way too much in my downtime. I love the gameplay and the events they do, but I wish they would tweak the energy and generators a bit to allow more fluid playtime. I’ve found other reviewers who also agree the game gets harder to play without spending money the higher you advance in levels; The 100 energy regeneration cap is honestly way too low once you reach around level 15-20 since the more advanced recipes take so much to make. I once splurged $15 for over 2,000 energy and it went FAST. If it takes 2 hours to reach 100 energy and most recipes require way over 100 energy to make, that leaves you with very little time to play. I understand they have to make money somehow on the app since it’s free and there aren’t adds (which is incredible and allows for seamless playing) but it feels like between the energy output and generator life there could be more balance. Other than that, literally such a fun game with endless fun stuff to make.

author: TalValen
title: Merge Cooking Suggestions
content:
The game is very addictive and the mini games make it just as interesting. Below I’ll state my qualms and suggestions. 


1. The 7-day daily reward, more specifically, the grand prize should not be cooking boosts and the additional 8-moves card. It should be something more useful like energy, which would help us complete levels faster. 

2. Some of the products are ridiculously priced. For example, a mango costing 700+ gems or a pear costing 500+ gems. 

3. The different events, for example the Bikini Bottom Bash Event, that you can rebuild, feels/is impossible to complete as the rewards are not sufficient. For example, if an order is completed, the reward does not scratch the surface for what is needed to complete a building in that event. 

4. The energy needs to recuperate at a faster rate. Waiting 3 hours for a full bar is discouraging. Also if I am rewarded additional energy from mini games that should not be added to the main energy bar which would stop the time from generating energy, it should be separate. 

5. ⁠The Renovation: there should be a feature where the player can complete all renovations that their coins allow. For example, if I have 2000 coins, I shouldn’t have to renovate and watch the character celebrate for each one. I should be able to renovate 3/4 places once my coins cover the costs. The single renovations are very tedious when done one by one.

author: AllSaints36
title: Fun but takes FOREVER at high levels unless you give the game a lot of real $$$
content:
I really wanted to love this game. It is much more fun at the lower levels but once you get to the higher levels, unless you want to spend hundreds of dollars on buying energy, it will take you several days to complete each round of recipes. 

I actually don’t mind spending money on games that are fair. I spent a little money at the lower levels for more energy or gems and enjoyed the time making new recipes. A game like this that requires very little brain power can be a nice way to unwind on a break or after work.

However, once I got to the higher levels, you need almost 2000 energy to complete everything and the game maxes at 100 so it’s not like you can earn more overnight. Because the higher levels require more energy, I spent some of my gems on energy but the gem cost doubled each time you replenish. 

Like most games, this game is designed for “free” play but also designed to extract as much money from the end user as possible. I don’t mind spending $15 on 2000 energy but since that could only be maybe an extra half hour of play, I can’t justify it. I also think the game gives you more extravagant dishes if you pay for energy so that you use more and more. Can’t justify it anymore. Deleted.

author: EmJayHD
title: Ridiculous
content:
I got to level 16, cleared most the board and had 2 fruit trays, and needed to make a pear.  It takes 16 lemons, which makes  8 coconuts, which makes 4 oranges, and 2 pomegranates turn into 1 pear.

Unfortunately both fruit trays wouldn’t yield more fruit after making 3 coconuts.  So I had to wait awhile for the trays to refresh only to go through this again and again.  When done with that one stupid pear - which took at least half a day - mostly waiting, not playing, I had another order to make some pear juice.  I didn’t bother. 

The biggest problem with this game is that it’s not built for long-term play.  

The game wants you to buy diamonds so you can buy virtual fruit so you can combine them to make pears faster.   Some of the items that take forever to make will cost over 100 diamonds.

I suppose the developers don’t care about a guy like me, because I’m patient, and I’m not paying to finish stuff faster, or to win some stupid race against a bot.  I’ve tried this game twice now and never got to level 20, because it takes way too long.

Overall fun game, but concept makes it repetitive and they’re surely trying to entice you to pay.  I could see parents paying a lot for their impatient kids.

Anyway, I’m deleting tonight and won’t be playing anymore.
